zh.prompt: 「这款产品是健康食品」——什么样的食品才算得上「健康食品」？
hints: 「健康」不是非黑即白，加工食品里也有健康的
看营养成分和配料表，而不是广告词
同一个词，超市货架和营养师口中的含义可能完全不同
zh.explanation: 「健康食品」的含义在两端被严重扭曲：一端说只有白水煮菜才健康，另一端把包装上的「健康」标签当作事实。真实的答案要看营养成分与配料——广告词不是定义。争论前先问：你说的「健康」是什么标准？

en.prompt: "This product is a healthy food" — what actually counts as "healthy food"?
hints: "Healthy" is not black-and-white; some processed foods are healthy
Read the nutrition facts and ingredient list, not the marketing words
The same word can mean very different things on a store shelf vs. in a dietitian's mouth
en.explanation: "Healthy food" gets distorted at both ends: one claims only boiled vegetables count, the other treats the package's "healthy" label as fact. The real answer lies in nutrition and ingredients — marketing words are not definitions. Before arguing, ask: what standard of "healthy" do you mean?
